            in = new Reader();
            out = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out)));
        }
    }

        int t = 1;
        while (t-- > 0) {
            process();
        }
        out.flush();
        out.close();
    }

    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;

    void process() throws IOException {
        int n = in.nextInt();

        dp[0][1] = 1;

                }
                if (j - 1 >= 0) {

                }
            }
